profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc., also listed as SYMBOTIC INC, is a public company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, with ticker symbol SYM and SEC CIK 0001837240. The company describes itself as a provider of end-to-end warehouse automation solutions for retailers and distributors. Its website says its Symbotic Systems combine dense storage, streamlined operations, and AI-enhanced software, and that its Symbotic Solutions can handle palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, and omnichannel operations. It states that goods from 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) can be automatically managed and fulfilled in their native packaging, with options for loose items and cold chain requirements. The company describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and technology at large, innovating through robotics and AI.

SEC records identify Symbotic Inc. as a for-profit public company. Massachusetts legal exposure records list 191 entries for the company.
